snippet.title: Corn Guard - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
In this retro-style arcade game, you have to save your corn from the crows!

Shoot the crows from a slingshot to prevent them from stealing corn!

Developed by Mild Microgames
Published by Xeneder Team
Also released on PlayStation 5 (Cross-Buy)
